choices: A compiler feature that automatically creates object fields
Providing an object's dependencies from outside rather than having the object create them itself
A way to inject code at runtime using reflection
A pattern where one class inherits from multiple parents
explanation: DI: instead of 'class Car { Engine e = new Engine(); }', write 'class Car { Engine e; Car(Engine e) { this.e = e; } }'. The caller decides which Engine to use. This makes Car testable (pass a mock Engine), configurable (pass a diesel or electric Engine), and loosely coupled.
